Our mission
The Roy and Diana Vagelos Division of Biology & Biomedical Sciences fosters training in interdisciplinary bioscience and cultivates the diverse career aspirations of our trainees. DBBS is responsible for recruiting pre-doctoral students of the highest caliber and ensuring that your academic training, co-curricular experiences and research prepare you for a productive and creative scientific career.
Students, faculty and staff share how DBBS provides a supportive learning environment for scientific discovery.
